login.title: Sign in to Agent Studio
login.subtitle: For platform administrators. Use your Admin account.

err.invalid: Wrong company code, username or password.
err.locked: This account is locked. Contact your company administrator.
err.network: Couldn't reach the server. Please try again.
err.server: Something went wrong, please try again later (code {code}).

login.mustChange: You need to change your password in Admin before using Studio.

totp.title: Two-step verification
totp.body: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
totp.useApp: Use a code from the app
totp.wrong: The code is incorrect or expired
totp.expired: Your verification session expired. Please sign in again.

session.expired: Your session has expired. Please sign in again.

forbidden.title: You don't have access to Agent Studio
forbidden.body: Agent Studio is only for platform administrators (platform_admin).

agents.title: Agents
agents.subtitle: Each agent = runtime + model profile + system prompt + workflows attached as tools. The Orchestrator only sees agents the user is granted.
agents.empty: No agents yet. The Orchestrator will answer every question itself.

attention.title: Needs attention
attention.body: {n} enabled agents are not granted to any tenant: {keys}

agents.orchLocked: This agent is the Orchestrator; it can't be disabled or deleted.

toast.disabled: Disabled {name}. The Orchestrator will no longer pick this agent.

delete.title: Delete agent {key}?
delete.body: This can't be undone. Agents with run history can only be disabled.

setOrch.title: Set {name} as the default Orchestrator?
setOrch.body: All messages of tenants without their own Orchestrator will go through this agent.

agents.truncated: Showing the first 200 agents. Use search to filter on the server.

errors.FORBIDDEN: You no longer have permission to do this
errors.VERSION_CONFLICT: This agent was just changed by someone else. The list was reloaded.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE: The selected item changed or is no longer valid ({field}). Reload and choose again.
errors.BASH_ACK_REQUIRED: Confirm you understand the risk of enabling Bash
errors.AGENT_IN_USE_AS_ORCHESTRATOR: This agent is the Orchestrator. Choose another Orchestrator first.
errors.AGENT_HAS_HISTORY: This agent has run history and can't be deleted. Disable it instead.
errors.AGENT_HAS_ACCESS: This agent is still granted to tenants/groups. Revoke access before deleting.
errors.ORCHESTRATOR_EXISTS: This tenant already has its own Orchestrator.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This item doesn't exist or was deleted.
errors.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some fields are invalid, please check.
errors.KEY_TAKEN: This key is already used by another agent
errors.AGENT_NOT_ORCHESTRATABLE: This agent can't be the Orchestrator yet (it is disabled or its runtime isn't supported).
errors.ORCHESTRATOR_DEFAULT_PROTECTED: The default Orchestrator can't be deleted.
